title: Tic-Tac-Toe Code
description: Adds the Tic-Tac-Toe code used by the Penguin Spy Agency from Club Penguin as a font and banner patterns.
body:
This mod adds a **font based on the Tic-Tac-Toe code** used by the Penguin Spy Agency in Club Penguin (as described in the Factual Informative Spy Handbook), as well as **29 banner patterns**: 27 based on the characters, and 2 for standalone versions of the cross and circle. The code structured as follow:

![Deciphering guide: write letters A to I left to right top to bottom in a tic-tac-toe grid; repeat for J to R with a cross, and for S to Z with a circle. The 27th character (bottom right corner with circle) is the Director's signature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7qiBvoTv/images/f68cbb5900658e39273cdecd10515e917948ecb1.png)

The font can be used by any [JSON text](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Text_component_format) (it has id `tictactoecode:tictactoe`), such as with the `/tellraw` or `/title` commands on in custom item names. If you have [Bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/mod/bookshelf-lib), you can also use the `/bookshelf font` command for easy uses.

The font supports:
* All 26 latin letters A to Z (upper and lowercase are displayed the same),
* The Director's signature, mapped to #.

**To get the banner patterns, craft the Banner Pattern item** and use it in a Loom, as you would with any other. It is crafted with one each of Paper, Snowball, and Feather.

![Screenshot of all 27 banner patterns in various colors.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7qiBvoTv/images/e9e8cfbd8e941464b09bbc86b96d1f07c34104b9.png)

This was inspired by Darkhax's font mods, such as [Pig Pen Cipher](https://modrinth.com/mod/pig-pen-cipher).
